name: Sweep-Pass Bootleg
formation: T Formation, End Right, Flanker Right

summary.motive: Convert sweep credibility into a moving-pocket flood throw against defenders frozen by run fits.
summary.whyItWorks: Every run-fit defender commits left for two seconds; when the quarterback reverses, the flood presents three levels against a defense running the wrong way.
summary.failureMode: The backside contain refuses the sweep bait and squeezes the rollout lane, forcing the throw early or forcing a scramble.

beats.title: 1. The Perfect Sweep Picture
beats.text: Both guards pull, the fullback dives, and the halfback crosses for the handoff — an identical copy of the play that has already gained yards twice.

beats.title: 2. The Full Carry-Out Left
beats.text: The quarterback completes the fake at depth and carries it two full steps toward the weak sideline while Will, the Mike, and the corner all chase left.

beats.title: 3. The Flood Forms Behind Him
beats.text: As the quarterback reverses into his rollout right, three receivers are already stacked at fifteen, ten, and minus-two depths — a full high-to-low flood.

beats.title: 4. The High-Low Answer
beats.text: The sky safety is pinned above the TE's deep route, so the quarterback throws to the ten-yard out where the Sam arrives a half-second late.

relations.tell: The tight end releases vertically instead of blocking — no true Lombardi sweep shows an end running a pass route.
